name: Salzburg Airport W. A. Mozart

runway.v: one runway, 15/33, 2,850 m long and 45 m wide

customs.v: customs and immigration 06:00 to 23:00 local, on request (0500-2200 UTC winter, 0400-2100 UTC summer)

hours.v: take-offs and landings 06:00 to 23:00 local time
hours.quote: The operating hours (take-off and landing) are from 06:00 to 23:00 (local time).

curfew.v: closed 23:00 to 06:00 (ambulance flights excepted); non-commercial flights land 06:00-22:00 and take off 07:00-22:00; commercial take-offs 06:00-22:00, commercial landings 22:00-23:00 only for aircraft under 84 dB
curfew.quote: Ambulance flights may also be carried out at night.

noise.v: no landing permit at any time for B727, B732, B747SP, DC10, MD80 series and TU154M (over 98 dB)
noise.quote: No landing permit for the following types of aircraft during the entire operating period

max_aircraft.v: aircraft of all sizes up to the B747-400
max_aircraft.quote: Salzburg Airport can be used by aircraft of all sizes up to the B747-400.

slots.quote: for the facilitated Airports Graz (GRZ), Innsbruck (INN), Klagenfurt (KLU), Linz (LNZ) and Salzburg (SZG)

handling.v: handled by the airport's own Traffic Handling team; the General Aviation Handling package is compulsory for aircraft over 3,500 kg MTOW
handling.quote: The package "General Aviation Handling" must be registered for aircraft over 3,500 kg MTOW.

fuel.v: Jet A1 and AVGAS 100LL; fuelling 05:30-21:30 local (0430-2030 UTC winter), prior notice to the operator outside these hours
fuel.quote: FUELLING 0430-2030 (0330-1930) Outside that time PN to the AD OPR necessary.

notes: AIP edition used: AIRAC set published 04 SEP 2026 (the 02 OCT 2026 LOWS page could not be opened); page dates vary (AD 2-1 dated 11 JUL 2024). The operator's technical-data page gives the runway as 2,750 m x 45 m plus a 100 m stopway, while the AIP gives 2,850 x 45 with SWY NIL; the AIP figure is used. Night rule times are local all year (operator). Customs UTC converted: 0500-2200 UTC in winter (CET) and 0400-2100 UTC in summer (CEST) both = 06:00-23:00 local. Short-notice handling bookings under 24 h carry a 25% surcharge. The operator's site links a PPR request form but does not state that PPR is mandatory.
